Topic 4.1: Crocheting of Personal Protective Equipment

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Crocheting of Personal Protective Equipment, part of PRODUCTION TECHNIQUES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested lea in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six General.

Key inquiry question: How can crocheting reduce the cost of purchasing personal protective equipment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Crocheting of Personal Protective Equipment together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Integrity: prudent use of resources as the learners make household articles using crocheting stitches.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Financial literacy as learners save costs by constructing their own PPEs.

Link to other subjects:

Learners relate construction of PPEs by use of crocheting to artistic skills learnt in creative art.
